maddeler.e:
اعتصموا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمُوا (iʕtaṣamū) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمُوا (uʕtuṣimū) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصِمُوا (iʕtaṣimū) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
